old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-rl7e","title":"Relay dedup keys use mutable hop-by-hop SCHC bytes and no longer suppress loops","description":"Correctness review found Node._process_received stores delivery_payload (the received SCHC encoding) in _relay_seen, while forwarding now decompresses, decrements Hop Limit, and recompresses under the next peer's authenticated SCHC context. A looped copy therefore has a different Hop Limit and may also use a different peer-specific encoding, so it will not match the cached bytes; locally originated packets have the same problem. The cache comment still claims it prevents relay loops, but it now only catches byte-identical encodings and allows repeated LoRa forwarding until Hop Limit exhausts.
